description.value: Burns Lake Public Library is the community library serving Burns Lake and the surrounding Lakes District in BC's Central Interior. It offers public computers, printing, photocopying, exam invigilation, meeting room rentals, and an extensive digital media collection. For touring cyclists, it represents a potential rest stop in a smaller community that sits along routes through the Central Interior.
